title: So cool and fun!!! very interesting!!
text: Everything was great! the arrangements were very easy and the guide was perfect, because he explained very interesting facts in a very easy and fun way. The activities we did and the places we visit were all very cool (bars, spots, streets) so we all had a very good time. Then there was a concert in a nice bar and it was an excellent and fun way to end it. We had loads of fun and I really recommend it.
author: 869cristinav
